subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: After preserving unrelated custom model IDs, should `gpt-5.6` remain a moving browser alias while `gpt-5.6-sol` stays permanently pinned to Sol?
rationale: The detector repair is mechanical, but future retargeting of a public CLI identifier is a durable compatibility policy that requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve both alias contracts
options.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` movable and `gpt-5.6-sol` pinned after narrowing detection to intended GPT/ChatGPT names.

options.title: Ship only pinned Sol
options.body: Expose only `gpt-5.6-sol` until maintainers explicitly want a moving generic identifier.

recommendation.title: Approve both alias contracts
recommendation.body: Keep `gpt-5.6` movable and `gpt-5.6-sol` pinned after narrowing detection to intended GPT/ChatGPT names.

likelyOwner.reason: The central routing files and adjacent browser-model work are predominantly integrated through this owner’s current-main history.
